Return a handler mapping instance ordered at Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE containing the DefaultServletHttpRequestHandler instance mapped to "/**"; or null if default servlet handling was not enabled.
items.translation: 返回一个按Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE排序的处理器映射实例，其中包含映射到"/**"的DefaultServletHttpRequestHandler实例；如果未启用默认 Servlet 处理，则返回null。

items.source: Extension of SimpleUrlHandlerMapping with support for more precise mapping of WebSocket handshake requests to handlers of type WebSocketHttpRequestHandler.
items.translation: 支持将 WebSocket 握手请求更精确地映射到类型为 WebSocketHttpRequestHandler 的处理器，从而扩展了 SimpleUrlHandlerMapping。

items.source: Return the HandlerMapping that contains the registered view controller mappings, or null for no registrations.
items.translation: 返回包含已注册的视图控制器映射的HandlerMapping，若无注册则返回null。
